summary: ONLYOFFICE is a self-hosted office suite designed to handle document editing, project management, and customer relationship tasks within a single interface. It provides collaborative tooling for teams needing an alternative to cloud-based office ecosystems. The software is distributed under the AGPL-3.0 licence and integrates with containerised environments.
goodFor: Teams looking to self-host an integrated workspace for document editing and basic collaboration behind their own firewall.
watchOut: The AGPL-3.0 licence places copyleft constraints on network services, which may affect how you integrate it into your internal infrastructure. Furthermore, running a comprehensive office suite with multiple backend services can introduce significant resource overhead.
deployNotes: As a containerised Node.js application, deployment typically requires persistent volume mounts for document storage and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination. You will also generally need to provision an external database instance depending on your scaling requirements.
